## Close - Senior Backend Engineer – Backend Platform

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/close/5bf4629b-d2ee-4129-980f-e31b96185c9c)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Backend Engineer building AI development tools and backend platform infrastructure for Close’s CRM. Enabling product teams through APIs, observability, migrations, and coding-agent guardrails.
Senior Backend Engineer building AI development tools and platform infrastructure for Close’s CRM
- Salary: $140,000 - $210,000 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Cloud, Flask, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Python, Rust, TypeScript, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Build backend platform capabilities used by four product teams
- Expand DevDawg cloud development environments for the full application stack
- Expand Spice automated code review and root-cause tooling, including safely approving more pull requests
- Build paved roads for the API layer, including REST blueprints, GraphQL schema, OpenAPI, realtime, authentication, and permissions
- Modernize backend and asynchronous compute frameworks, including Flask-to-FastAPI migration paths
- Establish production observability, metrics, alerting, and readiness standards
- Build shared backend services and primitives for eventing, event logs, database-change safety, migrations, delegated access, auditability, internal administration, and support APIs
- Set guardrails for coding agents through static analysis, linting, hooks, and test harnesses
- Role open at Senior and Staff levels
- Seasoned Python engineer; Python is the primary backend language
- Go, Rust, or TypeScript experience is welcome
- Shipped meaningful LLM-backed or agentic work to real users
- Uses coding agents in day-to-day workflow and has a clear point of view on their strengths and limitations
- Fluent in observability and production practice, including telemetry, metrics, tracing, alerting, and Sentry ownership
- Experience designing and shipping internet-facing APIs
- Production incident debugging and ownership of systems with customer impact

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building AI development tools and backend platform infrastructure for Close’s CRM. Enabling product teams through APIs, observability, migrations, and coding-agent guardrails.
Senior Backend Engineer building AI development tools and platform infrastructure for Close’s CRM
Role description:
• Build backend platform capabilities used by four product teams
• Expand DevDawg cloud development environments for the full application stack
• Expand Spice automated code review and root-cause tooling, including safely approving more pull requests
• Build paved roads for the API layer, including REST blueprints, GraphQL schema, OpenAPI, realtime, authentication, and permissions
• Modernize backend and asynchronous compute frameworks, including Flask-to-FastAPI migration paths
• Establish production observability, metrics, alerting, and readiness standards
• Build shared backend services and primitives for eventing, event logs, database-change safety, migrations, delegated access, auditability, internal administration, and support APIs
• Set guardrails for coding agents through static analysis, linting, hooks, and test harnesses
• Partner with Infrastructure, which owns AWS, Kubernetes, and datastores, while owning the application layer
• Collaborate directly with internal engineering users and potentially move between teams as work shifts
Role requirements:
• Role open at Senior and Staff levels
• Seasoned Python engineer; Python is the primary backend language
• Go, Rust, or TypeScript experience is welcome
• Shipped meaningful LLM-backed or agentic work to real users
• Uses coding agents in day-to-day workflow and has a clear point of view on their strengths and limitations
• Fluent in observability and production practice, including telemetry, metrics, tracing, alerting, and Sentry ownership
• Experience designing and shipping internet-facing APIs
• Production incident debugging and ownership of systems with customer impact
• Experience carrying a pager for production systems
• Builder-first approach focused on rapid adoption
• Ability to work directly with internal engineering customers
• Must be legally able to work in the US; visa requirements must be explained
Benefits:
• Competitive pay plus an organization-wide goal-based bonus
• ~5 weeks of PTO to start
• 1-week all-company Winter Holiday Break
• Paid US holidays
• 2 extra PTO days for every year with Close
• 80% Work Option: choose a standard 5-day week or a 4-day week at 80% pay
• Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers
• 1-month paid sabbatical every 5 years
• Two medical plans with Close covering 99% of the premium for US residents
• Dental and Vision coverage
• HSA and FSA
• Company-paid Long-Term Disability
• 401(k) contribution match up to 6%, vested immediately
• Funding for best-in-class developer tools
Tech stack:
AWS, Cloud, Flask, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Python, Rust, TypeScript, Go
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsUKSkilledWorkerVisa=true.
